rationale: The agent verified identity correctly using full name and zip, matched to a single user. It retrieved orders and details via tools, confirmed the order was pending, and gathered the user’s desired changes. It summarized the exact changes (backpack variant and address to default) and requested explicit confirmation before making any write. The subsequent modify call updated the backpack variant and retained the default Charlotte address (which already matched the order), and the agent accurately reported the outcome. Payment via gift card was consistent with the tool state and the modification used the gift card; the final information given to the user was correct. No unsupported fabrications were relied upon since the write result confirmed the selected backpack variant. No writes were performed without confirmation and no policy violations are evident.
